evidence.why: Exact owner lookup, null guard and forwarding call.

facts.rationale: Corrects the obsolete fv.kb.hat.x0 field path to the canonical u.kb.hat.x0 while preserving the existing guarded owner-to-helper behavior.
facts.value: Receives the Hammer Item_GObj, resolves its Item, and reads its owner. If the owner is NULL it returns; otherwise it casts the owner to Fighter_GObj* and forwards it to ftKb_SpecialAirLw_800F539C, which clears GET_FIGHTER(gobj)->u.kb.hat.x0. The callback returns no value and performs no direct Item-field assignment.
